description:
Replace the old dashboard-only direction with a graph-first redesign contract for swarm-manager.

This research should:
- audit the current swarm-manager UX, routes, stores, and entity relationships
- inspect the prompt-manager sidebar + graph implementation and identify the real reuse/extraction seam versus prompt-manager-specific graph code
- define the canonical node and edge model for captures, backlog items, initiatives, scenarios, runs, and flow/reference surfaces
- define the initial graph lenses (work topology, lifecycle/flow, operations) and what each lens shows by default
- define the shell IA: sidebar, graph canvas, inspector, header controls, settings/info/reference placement, and mobile behavior
- define the hard-cut migration strategy so the new workspace replaces the tabbed shell cleanly with no long-lived compatibility layer
- identify performance constraints, clustering/default-filter rules, and anti-chaos guardrails for the graph

Useful signal already exists in the archived dashboard research around initiative service gaps, backlog filtering gaps, and narrow overview data; carry forward anything still applicable but discard the dashboard-page assumptions that no longer fit.

Deliverables:
- graph workspace architecture document
- canonical node/edge contract
- lens definitions and inspector action model
- rollout and cleanup plan
- recommended execute-item decomposition
name: swarm-manager-graph-workspace-contract
title: Define the Swarm Manager Graph Workspace Contract
